method: Existing Adaptive Naming System v0.4.0, throughput-rebalanced job-local generation; no stable method change or benchmark
purpose: Increase candidate supply while applying cheap intrinsic triage first. Reality and trademark work is layered by candidate value; no deep four-jurisdiction diligence is required for raw drafts.

screening_policy.pre_owner: exact and obvious near identity + .com posture + practical public trademark risk screen + final language/batch review
screening_policy.unknown_policy: record uncertainty; do not convert missing evidence into legal clearance
screening_policy.time_policy: stop deepening a normal candidate when marginal information value is low; explicit red signal stops expensive follow-up

positive_brief.object: Long-term commercial umbrella organization for research, education, software/tools, publishing, public knowledge and creative projects.
positive_brief.value_relation: Shared knowledge supports independent perspectives and creation; contributions can enrich the common base without imposing one view.
positive_brief.name_job: Distinct, credible, memorable organization identity with room for many projects; name need not encode the whole mission.
positive_brief.expression: Meaningful, calm, dependable, restrained inventiveness. Compact spoken effort and orderly written contour are soft preferences only.
positive_brief.portfolio: Compact proper-name coinages, motivated semantic fusions, transparent compounds, conceptual or relational forms. Avoid cloning prior survivor roots or suffix families.

candidates.name: Avenfold
candidates.intent: 把个人路径与共同积累折叠进一个可继续展开的整体。

candidates.name: Elseframe

candidates.name: Kinverse

candidates.name: Accordly

candidates.name: Eachfold

candidates.name: Manyframe

candidates.name: Shareward

candidates.name: Seenwise
candidates.intent: 同一事物可以被不同方式理解。

candidates.name: Anewfold
candidates.intent: 旧知识在新视角下重新展开并进入下一轮积累。
candidates.caveat: a new fold听写分词明显。

candidates.name: Framewell
candidates.intent: 为理解与创造提供可靠但不僵化的框架。
candidates.caveat: 可能像设计顾问或工具。

candidates.name: Openbraid

candidates.name: Relune

candidates.name: Arclume
